Ellie — thanks for flagging, and sorry for the confusion.

Quick notes:
- I scheduled the demo at 15:00 UTC in the original invite; it should translate to 17:00 CEST (you), 01:00 AEST (next day for Tom), etc.
- The floating-time behavior you're seeing can happen when an .ics is created without a TZID or when a client rewrites the event on forward.

Plan: I'll ask Marissa to recreate the event pinned to UTC (explicit TZ) and include the org-wide invite (no forwarding). We'll send a fresh invite and also attach a one‑page MAP so your procurement and security folks have the next steps.

Proposed slots (all in UTC):
- 15:00 UTC / Apr 29
- 18:00 UTC / Apr 29 (more friendly to APAC)

If the 18:00 UTC option works better for Tom in Sydney, we'll send that as the canonical invite and include explicit timezone info in the description.

I'll also include a short note for recipients: "Do not forward — accept and then forward the calendar entry created on your calendar to preserve local time."

Thanks,
